mapper.select: SELECT og.start_time startTime, og.end_time endTime FROM outgoing_personnel op LEFT JOIN outgoing og ON og.out_id = op.out_id LEFT JOIN u_user uu ON uu.user_id = op.user_id AND uu.status_cd = '0' LEFT JOIN u_org_staff_rel uosl ON uosl.staff_id = uu.user_id AND uosl.status_cd = '0' LEFT JOIN u_org uo ON uo.org_id = uosl.org_id AND uo.status_cd = '0' LEFT JOIN t_dict td ON td.status_cd = uosl.rel_cd AND td.table_name = 'u_org_staff_rel' AND td.table_columns = 'rel_cd' WHERE uu.`name` = #{name} AND uo.org_name = #{department} AND op.status_cd = '0' AND og.status_cd = '0' AND og.state = 3 AND (DATE_FORMAT(og.start_time,'%Y-%m-%d') = #{attendanceDate} OR DATE_FORMAT(og.end_time,'%Y-%m-%d') = #{attendanceDate})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO business_outgoing_personnel(b_id, personnel_id, user_id, out_id, operate) VALUES (#{bId}, #{personnelId}, #{userId}, #{outId}, #{operate})

INSERT INTO outgoing_personnel(personnel_id, user_id, out_id, b_id, status_cd) SELECT personnel_id, user_id, out_id, b_id, '0' FROM business_outgoing_personnel WHERE b_id = #{bId} AND operate = #{operate}
